history.summary: A tight, self-contained prototype that faithfully reproduces the episode's force-mapping grid and runs the spoken inverse-alpha formula through real in-browser arithmetic rather than hard-coding an answer — and it reports the honest result (a 9-digit match) instead of overclaiming. Verified against the code and screenshots: every acceptance criterion holds, all displayed numbers trace to verified IDEA.json figures or simple labeled calculations, and the mobile layout collapses cleanly with no overflow. Minor polish items remain (button-face wording, an unused JSON field, incomplete ARIA grid roles) but nothing blocks publishing.
